_comment: 🧩️ This plugin's contribution to the repository test platform. It registers NO reference implementation: every artifact `📸️remodel` owns is a semio-NATIVE document (photogrammetric reconstruction), carried in `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio`, and no third party reads or writes that envelope — the per-subset manifests under `🗿️artifacts/**/🪆️subsets/*/🧪️oracle/🔣️component.json` record that as a `noOracleDecision` each. What DOES belong here is the native host package every case of this plugin links, because `oracleHostPackagesFor` walks up from the case owner and only an ancestor manifest is consulted.
